interactions.note: Only Total Cover blocks a chosen target. Creatures give at most Half Cover. Area spells aren't refused. Existing tests cover the session refusal, Three-Quarters cover, a creature in the line, and a multi-target Bless.

interactions.note: An 'each creature' area must take in unnamed creatures inside it and leave out named ones outside it. The new positive and abuse tests aim the Cone and leave a creature that is inside it off the list.
For an 'of your choice' area, the caller's list only narrows. Already covered by test_sleep_doesnt_reach_a_creature_outside_its_sphere.
Self-targeting with Magic Missile sets off the caster's own Shield offer. The test answers it False, so the darts' damage is what gets checked.
Choosing yourself applies only when the spell targets a creature. Light on the caster must be refused.

An invalid target must stay unaffected even when the save could not have succeeded. The DC is raised past any d20 so the test can't pass on a lucky seed, which is the reason the earlier tests were refuted.
The slot is spent only when the spell is actually cast. A target out of range is refused before any slot is spent.
The player must not be able to probe a creature's type. Already covered by existing tests.
A spell with no save shows a visible 'did nothing'. Already covered by existing tests.

abuse.reason: Burning Hands is named at the far goblin. The near goblin, also inside the Cone, still takes the damage.

abuse.case: Naming yourself as the target of an object-targeting spell (Light on the caster)
abuse.reason: New catalogue entry. Light on the caster is refused cleanly with an 'object' message.

not_testable.reason: Only the exclusion is out of scope: 'unless the creature must be Hostile or specifically a creature other than you'. No in-scope spell requires a Hostile creature or a creature other than the caster. The positive half is tested (Cure Wounds, Healing Word, Mage Armor, Magic Missile on the caster), and so is a negative (Light can't be pointed at the caster).

Every in-scope spell that targets another creature has a perceptible effect (damage, a condition, a visible ward, a spoken Command). No subset spell has a subtle effect whose target could fail to notice it.
The example subtle effect, reading thoughts (Detect Thoughts and similar), isn't in the implemented spell subset.

summary:
This is a revisit. Before it, the unit's committed tests had no positive for #1, #4 and #8 and no negative for #3 and #9. I added 8 tests to tests/srd/test_spells.py, all green. All 83 tests in the file pass, and ruff check and ruff format are clean.

- **#1 positive:** Light makes a named object glow.
- **#3:** Magic Missile can send its darts at the caster (positive; the test declines her automatic Shield reaction). Light on the caster is refused with an 'object' reason (negative).
- **#4:** an aimed Burning Hands hits a goblin inside the Cone that wasn't named (positive). Leaving that goblin off the list doesn't spare it (abuse).
- **#8:** Hold Person at a Wolf leaves it unaffected and rolls no save (positive). The test raises the DC above any d20 result, so it can't pass on a lucky seed, the reason the earlier tests were refuted. The same cast through Session.execute spends the slot and does nothing (abuse).
- **#9 negative:** a target out of range is refused with 'range' before the slot is spent.

I didn't rewrite the refuted duplicates. #3's Hostile / other-than-you exclusion, #6 and #7 stay out of scope. I added one cheat to the abuse catalogue: naming yourself as the target of an object-only spell.
